title: Apple reportedly cancels production boost for the iPhone XR
text: Apple reportedly cancels production boost for the iPhone XR Tuesday, 6 November 2018 ( 21 minutes ago ) In September, Apple launched three new iPhones, the premium iPhone XS and iPhone XS Max that start at Rs 99,900 and go all the way up to Rs 144,900. And then there is the “affordable” iPhone XR that starts at Rs 76,900 for base model, and goes all the way up to Rs 91,900.
